content: “Nandöng niporöcnai son kombiarut, nocho tong bumbum au matogotmaha worocha nocho nakain forona kanong tuctuc towa.”
Ihoroc yuna owi amnaho Hibru mata kombigungmaha mata mayi öpgon idiya Polho mata sakaun fiuna ingoroc inogoc,

“Noc ngoi Yuda amna au. Macnaho böcsa Tarsus Silisia gurocin woce noc bagoc mahong nocho Yerusalem ngocin itmaina macfigot. Kombic kombic amna moröma mano Gamaliel yu ombu sakung nonihon gendic nongoru noc fandat nanuna nocho kombingbödehat. Tongo nocho ‘Kopotorochon nongoru tandup towa’ yongo irotna aranggum toup uuna koing sogot. Soni ambarac toroc kiap önga tangma worocotma nocho tongidot.
Irotna aranggum uuna nocho owi amna kombing tobic tobichon uyap tanidangma yu dongya ombungidung. Owihu o amnahu nocho yu fogit akep tongga yi bucin fohongidot.

Öret socsoc böchon amna dugo o Yuda nanohon amna dugo yui ambarac nochon toroc kiap wo kombingbödeang. Tongo yu ogep worochon fatno kanup. Bongono au wömai nocho kombing tobic tobic suraro Damaskas bucin idungma yu fogida Yerusalem mata youpdec fohong yuangot’ yongo kombigot. Tongo nocho öret socsoc böchon amna dugo ot onguna yuho ‘öc, ogep tiruc’ yongo nucni Damaskas bucin idungma yuha yongburoc bapiya au irim tongo namogung.
Namuya nocho uyap ongga urop Damaskas ambehecgon edeya apmanodec momdecma yaguno koingo wariwari simbang nocdec ohogoc.
“Ohuna nocho gurocdec möngga edeya mata au ingoroc öngkuboc: ‘Sol, Sol, goc yaha noc ti obukoc obukocha taroc’
Ihoroc yuna nocho yogot, ‘Moröma, goc numa?’ ihoroc inoya yuho nanogoc, ‘Nocu Yesu Nasaretma gocho noc ti obukoc obukocha taroc.’
Yu ihoroc nanogoc mahong amna nocot idungma yu yagunogon agung, matano wömai tuctugo makombigung.

Tuna nocho wönggon inogot, ‘Moröma nocu tingting sinom towa yongo kombiharoc?’ Ihoroc yoya Morömaho nanogoc, ‘Goc idongmina Damaskas bucsae ongoi. Wocin wömai amna auho gocot engmuna nocho youp soworengsitma woroc ganong tuctuc tangoc.’
Ihoroc nanuna nucnaiho obuna sogitmuya Damaskas nangat tonggung. Yagunho wömai koingo sinom danna sakang namuna danna sum fadoc.
“Nocho Damaskas wocin edeya amna au mano Ananaias yu nocot eboc. Yu wömai Kopotorochon nongoru sumboda worochon toroc itongidoc. Worocha tongga Yuda nano wocin ididungma yu Ananias anggendingidung.
“Oro yuho nocot ambehecgon engmuna ingoroc nanogoc: ‘Sol oröcna, dara wönggon forihi.’ Ihoroc nanuna wohogon danna orokuna nocho yu agot.

Aayai yuho nanogoc, ‘Ombusakung nonihon Kopotoroc yu ‘gocho inoin irot kombic kombic tuctugo kombiangoroc’ yongo goc eragoc. O ihorocgon ‘gocho yuhon Nongnongo Amna wo angtangtang tongga yuhon duc matano kombihi’ yongo Kopotorocho goc soworegoc.
Tongo gocho yuhon youp amna itmina manomano agorocma orin kombigorocma worochon yong tuctuc mata owi amna ambarac fandat inong tongungoroc.
Oro goc tong unim tirocha. Goc idongga wömunoya Yesu indangga yuhon madec yamuc guiya yuho turongoya sac tongdup tong gamontac.’ Ananias yu ihoroc nanogoc.
Tuna mit nocho Yerusalem ongmaina öret socsoc bucin dönac yongga itmaina duc itu togoc.
Duc itu tongmaina Moröma aya yu ingoroc nanogoc: ‘Goc karupgon idongmina Yerusalem imi fauna ongoi. Yerusalem nano yu gochon ducdecma nochon fatmata makombing tobining.’

Morömaho ihoroc nanuna nocho inogot, ‘Moröma, Yerusalem nano yu nochon foro kombingbödeang. Yu wömai kombiang, nocho osuc itongmaina Yuda nanohon fatmata yocyoc bucin woce woce öngmaina kombing tobic tobic owi amna fogito tosipdec dongga yi bucin fohong yungidot.

“Ihoroc toya yuho gochon youp amna Stiven wuya omboc. Tuya bongono wocinu wömai nocho ambehecgon itmaina Stiven wot omom togungma worochon tec tohomumöcno yangtoregot. Tongo nocho yuhon toroc kiap wömuno wo aaya ogep idoc.’
Nocho ihoroc inoya Morömaho nanogoc, ‘Goc Yerusalem imi fauna ongoi. Nocho goc ganong muaya goc korungon ongmina bumbumyi nano ot ongungoroc.’ Morömaho ihoroc nanogoc.”
Polho bumbumyi nano ot onggongon mata yogocmaha tongga owi amnaho wo kombingga ec imuya ambaracho kararat yongmuya yogung, “Wuya ompun. Amna ihorocnoho guroc koroc ngocin wec itongicha.”
Yu ihoroc kararat yongmuya tecno fuu deuya morop morop fogito dedec muyu woce woce moruya ögung.

Ihoroc tuya namba wan ofisa yu tawa amnani inuna yu Pol sogito ino gombo ganang tonggung. Gombo ganang tohuya ofisaho tawa amnani inogoc, “Sonu amna ngo bokotdec ficurong imongmuya yuho owi amna yaha mambodungmahon foro ninuna kombina.”
Ihoroc yuna tawa amnaho Pol sogida orung oburo fetho siuya Polho ofisa inogoc, “Kombihi, nocu Röm kantrihon morömo. Sontho noc mata youpdec abe matohongnui bokotdec notnotha woi angit itachu nuhun.”
Ihoroc inuna tawa amnahon ofisanoho mata woroc kombingga soroc yongmuna namba wan ofisaot ongga inogoc, “Oro goc amna worocha ting tontaroc? Yu woi Röm kantrihon morömo au yo.”
Ihoroc inuna namba wan ofisaho mata woroc kombingga Polot ongmuna inogoc, “Goc nanti, goc boinno Röm kantrihon morömo itarocha woha muno?” Yuna Polho yogoc, “Noc boinno sinom Röm kantrihon morömo.”

Ihoroc yuna ofisaho inogoc, “Kombihi, noc ‘Röm kantrihon morömo itiwa’ yongo möneng koböcma sinom gavman imongga Römphon morömo itat.” Ihoroc yuna Polho yogoc, “Nocu ihoroc muno. Macnaho bauna nocho Römphon morömo idot.”

Ihoroc yuna tawa amnaho yu bokotdec wotwotha togungma yu mata woroc kombingga Pol imu fauna onggung. Onguya namba wan ofisaho Pol sendec orung oburo fetho sigocmaha kombingbanac togoc. Yaha Pol yu Römphon morömo idocmaha.
Pol yu Yuda nanohon amna moröma kaunsilot itmuna yong tuctuc mata inogoc

Oro kembotsum namba wan ofisaho ingoroc kombigoc, ‘Yuda nano yu foro yaha sinom Pol mata firing tarang’ ihoroc kombingga yu Pol asan imongga mata siuna öret socsoc böchon amna moröma orin Yuda nanohon amna dugo yu engsuran togung. Engsuran tuya ofisaho Pol yangato teuna amna morömaho yangamin idongga idoc.
